#
# An excerpt of two board traces of one depth-tested GLES2 frame on the
# NanoPC-T6, for the frame builder's depth/stencil proof
# (src/mali/frame_tests.rs): the command-stream words of the frame's two
# draws and of its end, and the raw memory of the buffer that holds the
# framebuffer descriptor and the draws' descriptors.
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor 1.5.0, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1.
# The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-19-frame-depth/zs.c: a 64x64
# RGBA8 FBO with a GL_DEPTH24_STENCIL8_OES renderbuffer on both points,
# cleared blue, depth 1.0, stencil 0x5a; green at z -0.5 over x [-0.5, 1],
# then red at z +0.5 over x [-1, 0.5], each a uniform colour.
#
# Source "depth": depth test LESS, write on ("pixels 4096: not as predicted
#   0"). Source "nodepth": the same with the depth test off ("not as
#   predicted 0"). Both by tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh, which runs
#   PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync PANDECODE_DUMP_FILE=...
#   mesa-depth.pandecode sha256 34f1665ed9903719b9559deaeba8251a1a3e7179d26fdcfb306303caab6901d5
#   mesa-nodepth.pandecode sha256 c279a3a4409939981f1d1cc8a5d5b7204ff069b7f3a18f52930660bf3927cacf
# Source "mask": the same FBO cleared blue, then glColorMask(R only) and a
#   white clear ("not as predicted 0": magenta), which Mesa draws as a quad:
#   the quad draw's words and the descriptor buffer.
#   mesa-mask.pandecode sha256 83a6fe1c97d547fd95c3ff5cf32b044b408a3f5be8b685555fbf8acde467629b
# Source "nocolour": cleared blue, depth 1.0, depth test LESS; green at z
#   -0.5 with glColorMask(none) (depth only), then red at z +0.5 over the
#   whole target ("not as predicted 0": columns 0-15 red, the rest blue):
#   the colourless draw's words and the descriptor buffer.
#   mesa-nocolour.pandecode sha256 1fd9f04d4673211a8bd31ff8357f400b42df613cd3d371e5c4d3c085227272d7
# Each block is headed by its line range in the full file.
